description: Defines immutable data models for 'Chapter' and 'Section' used to represent structured content in a flutter application. Includes JSON serialization/deserialization methods and some simple utility functions.

classes.name: Chapter
classes.description: Represents a chapter with a unique id, title, and list of sections. Provides factory for JSON deserialization, toJson for serialization, and a findSectionById method.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a section within a chapter with id, heading, and body. Provides factory for JSON deserialization and toJson for serialization.

methods.name: Chapter.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Chapter instance from a JSON-like map, parsing the 'sections' list.

methods.name: Chapter.toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Chapter instance into a JSON-like map.

methods.name: Chapter.findSectionById
methods.description: Finds and returns a Section by its id within the chapter, or null if not found.

methods.name: Section.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Section instance from a JSON-like map.

methods.name: Section.toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Section instance into a JSON-like map.
